PILE.gloss: a collection of objects laid on top of each other
PILE.definition: A collection of objects laid on top of each other.

TILE.gloss: a flat thin rectangular slab used to cover surfaces
TILE.definition: A flat thin rectangular slab (as of fired clay or rubber or linoleum) used to cover surfaces.

GILT.gloss: having the deep slightly brownish color of gold
GILT.definition: Having the deep slightly brownish color of gold.

GET.gloss: come into the possession of something concrete or abstract
GET.definition: Come into the possession of something concrete or abstract.
GET.example: She got a lot of paintings from her uncle.

LET.gloss: make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen
LET.definition: Make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen.
LET.example: This permits the water to rush in.

LIE.definition: Be located or situated somewhere; occupy a certain position.

LEG.definition: A human limb; commonly used to refer to a whole limb but technically only the part of the limb between the knee and ankle.

TIP.definition: The extreme end of something; especially something pointed.

TIE.gloss: neckwear consisting of a long narrow piece of material worn under a collar and tied in…
TIE.definition: Neckwear consisting of a long narrow piece of material worn (mostly by men) under a collar and tied in knot at the front.
TIE.example: He stood in front of the mirror tightening his necktie.

PET.gloss: a domesticated animal kept for companionship or amusement
PET.definition: A domesticated animal kept for companionship or amusement.

PIT.definition: A sizeable hole (usually in the ground).
PIT.example: They dug a pit to bury the body.

PIE.gloss: dish baked in pastry-lined pan often with a pastry top
PIE.definition: Dish baked in pastry-lined pan often with a pastry top.

LIP.gloss: either of two fleshy folds of tissue that surround the mouth and play a role in speaking
LIP.definition: Either of two fleshy folds of tissue that surround the mouth and play a role in speaking.
